provenance.classification: loot means a reachable template has LootTable/Items NBT, a processor appends loot, or a pack KubeJS block loot modifier supplies loot to a reachable container. no_loot is emitted only when all reachable pools/templates/processors are found and reviewed. unknown means missing/unreviewed dynamic content or a non-pool structure with potentially code-defined behavior.
provenance.pool_walk: Start pool, fallback pools, list/single pool elements, and all non-empty jigsaw connector pools referenced by reachable templates are followed. This is an over-approximation of randomized jigsaw paths.
provenance.resource_precedence: KubeJS data overrides mod jar resources by resource ID; mod jars are read in filename order where duplicate jar resources exist.
provenance.source: Installed Prism TFG Modern Minecraft 1.20.1 client/mod resources and KubeJS data; no game launch or save writes.
